items.front: turns as measures of rotation — what should I remember?
items.back: 1 full turn = 2 half turns = 4 quarter turns.

items.front: full, half and quarter turns — what should I remember?
items.back: 1 quarter turn = 90°; 1 half turn = 180°; 1 full turn = 360°.

items.front: acute, right, obtuse and straight angles — what should I remember?
items.back: Acute < 90°; right = 90°; obtuse is between 90° and 180°; straight = 180°.

items.front: measuring turns with an angle tool — what should I remember?
items.back: 1 full turn = 2 half turns = 4 quarter turns.

items.front: clockwise and anticlockwise movement — what should I remember?
items.back: 1 quarter turn = 90°; 1 half turn = 180°; 1 full turn = 360°.

items.front: directions after turns — what should I remember?
items.back: Acute < 90°; right = 90°; obtuse is between 90° and 180°; straight = 180°.
